text_block_list.text:
We continue training as Mayano's debut
draws
closer...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer! ☆ I finished my third lap on the
dirt track!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ♪ I've still got lots of fuel left
too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: C'mon, what should I do next?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Considering all my training regimens up
until now,
don't you think today was on
the easy side?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She's right. I specifically made today's
training
lighter, with an emphasis on
racing on the dirt
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's still growing, so I don't want to put
too
much of a burden on her legs...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
Do you want to do something a bit more
intense?

text_block_list.text:
Nope! I want something more than "a
bit" more
intense!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run in the Twinkle Series,
y'know!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm so excited, and there's so much to
learn!
Everyone who runs there is so
twinkly...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
If I wanna race in the Twinkle Series, I
have to get
faster!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! On top of that...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
You think I can do even more, don't
you?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yay! An A+ for Maya! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the two of us begin to build
on the
basic formula by trying out
various training
methods...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Studying races... Studying?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Haha! ♪ It feels like I'm dashing up the
stairs to
adulthood. ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: This is also a form of training, you know.

text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. ☆ It's just that I'm very
good at
studying!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
The video's already over? But it's only
been thirty
minutes!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! You're just trying to keep
me on my
toes.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: So this... is how adults tease each other! ☆ Eee! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Actually...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. That's enough with this
video.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Number one is going to dash ahead like vroom! at the third turn.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I can already tell. Go ahead and
check if
I'm right if you want.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Since she's brought it up, I fast forward
the video
to check...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: See? ☆ Just like I said!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! Let's do another one! Keep 'em
coming!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
We end up watching all of the videos I
prepared...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh. Was that really the last video?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh, okay! Fine by me! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: We move to the pool to do some cardio.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You're going to test how far I can go
without
taking a breath, aren't you?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
By the way, how far do I have to go for
you to say
I'm the best?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Seventy-five meters is pretty standard
for a racer
experienced in this training.
Since this is her first
time, one hundred
meters would really be
something.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But I've heard there was a racer that
went for 300
meters. Well, since we're
here...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Copy that! I'm off!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Gasp!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Why couldn't I do it?! I only got halfway!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Even halfway—or 150 meters—is still a
great
record. If she keeps practicing, she
might actually
reach 300 meters...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hmph! Lemme try again!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I'll get to 300 meters next time! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I didn't think I'd need to do it
twice.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But I think I figured it out while I was
swimming.
How to save up my energy,
that is. ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! So I wanna try it out right away!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
By the way, if I get it this time, you have
to come
up with some more training for
me, okay? ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Heehee! ☆ Do you copy?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
A short while later, I find myself
struggling to
come up with something
new for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
